pricingSummary: Google Meet is the best free option for Google Workspace users. Zoom Pro at 13.33 dollars/mo offers the best overall experience. Teams is included with Microsoft 365. For AI meeting summaries, Zoom AI Companion and Luma AI Notes are the leaders.

faqs.question: What is the best free video conferencing tool?
faqs.answer: Google Meet is the best free option. It offers 60-minute meetings for up to 100 participants, screen sharing, recording, and AI meeting notes with Google Workspace. Zoom free tier limits meetings to 40 minutes.

faqs.question: Which video tool has the best AI meeting summaries?
faqs.answer: Zoom AI Companion on Pro plan and Luma AI Notes both offer excellent meeting summaries. Zoom generates action items, key decisions, and follow-up tasks. Luma AI notes are structured with agenda items and decisions.

faqs.question: How do I reduce Zoom fatigue for remote teams?
faqs.answer: Implement no-meeting days (2-3 per week), use async video tools like Loom for updates, keep meetings under 30 minutes, and require cameras-off for internal meetings. Use Slack Huddles for quick 5-minute check-ins instead of scheduling meetings.

faqs.question: Which tool is best for client calls?
faqs.answer: Zoom is the most professional choice for client calls. It has the widest adoption, reliable quality, and branded meeting rooms on paid plans. Google Meet is also acceptable for less formal client interactions.

faqs.question: Can I record meetings for team members in different timezones?
faqs.answer: Yes, all listed tools support meeting recording. Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams auto-generate recordings with transcripts. Share recordings in your team Slack channel or project management tool for async review.
